about: A stand-in for the model on a tournament's page, for the tournament-* questions of questions.json whose expect.kind is other: per question (lower case), the reply it gives. Some are honest phrasings of the facts, which the guard (lib/ask/tournament.ts tournamentReplyOk) passes; some invent a name, a number, a result or a forecast, which it must refuse, so the player gets the code-built answer. Used offline by npm run test:ask (lib/ask/tournament.test.ts) and by a stand-in server's /v1/messages.

replies.who is the best fielder: I can't tell that from this tournament's scorecards. They do show Sameer and Manoj level on 3 wickets.
replies.who was the best captain: Sachin was the best captain, leading Lions with 120 runs.
replies.which team looks strongest for next seas: Lions should win again next season.
replies.was it a close tournament: Yes, Eagles beat Lions by 3 runs in the final.
